items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Joe Glazer come and say, Jesus Christ, do people want to dance? I said, no, you ain't playing the right music, Mr. Glazer.

ctx.x: But Mario, we used to sit on and talk.

Now we was together, we'd meet him, never talk about the music. What is when we talk about different things we can understand, what, what, what, what we're playing. Yeah. Pops, since it's not, since it's not we're playing, he says, what you hitting in there? I said, don't hit that, hit this note here. What is it? Hit this note here. Search the ball. Okay, man. Don't look at the wind, what's going on? Remember, just like oil, oil on there. What you mean, Pops? Oh, no. Yeah. I'm like, oh, no. I'm like, oh, no. I'm…
Yeah, all the same style. The same thing, see?

items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I never said what Joe Glazer told Louie.

ctx.x: You know that's something I ain't never want? There's two things I was promised. I always promised a typewriter and one of them things. And I don't know nothing about either one of them. I never said what Joe Glazer told Louie. Louie bought one of them, he was that one finger. My sister. Yeah. One, there you go. Joe said, that one damn finger gets you in trouble. That was one finger dead, man.
I got a letter he wrote home, man, to me.
